policy: Only photographs whose subject AND licence were checked are stored and displayed. Where a verified, permissibly licensed photograph of the exact place was not found, the record is marked imageStatus=unavailable and the UI shows a designed 'photograph unavailable' state. No AI-generated or unrelated stock image is used as a representation of a real place.
downloadMethod: Images were retrieved through the workspace image-search tool (search-engine thumbnail proxy) and saved locally. Original source and licence were checked on the Wikimedia Commons file page or the publisher's attribution. Derivative WebP files were generated locally with ImageMagick (resize, strip metadata, quality 70-82).
